# Manual allowlist (fully trusted and exempt from gate challenges)
#
# Edit this file directly to add fixed IPs, home or office egress IPs, or other sources
# that need unconditional trust. During deployment, ops/sync_whitelist.py generates
# docs/lists/whitelist.txt; do not edit the generated file.
#
# Format:
#   ASN/<ASN number>
#   IP-CIDR/<IP>/<prefix>    IPv4 accepts /24–/32; IPv6 accepts /64–/128. Use /32 or /128 for a single IP.
#
# Trailing comments after # are removed; blank lines are ignored.

# Fully trusted individual IPs
IP-CIDR/97.64.18.11/32
IP-CIDR/176.122.161.108/32

# ASN/64500                       # ASN to allow
